name: Provincial Palace
scope: The standing Palacete Provincial, including its long ornamental elevation facing Praça Heliodoro Balbi, masonry basement, short returns and mapped connected rear range.
era: Nineteenth-century Palacete Provincial as restored and reopened as a museum centre in 2009.

originalReview.notes: Fidanza’s dated album plate shows the former police headquarters, now Palacete Provincial, with the front return, cornice, arched fenestration and roof. The period photograph was published in the 1901–02 Álbum do Amazonas.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Qualla’s historical image was checked first. Its upload credits an uploader rather than a specific archive or witnessed publication. Architectural imagery used is the independently verified 1901–02 Fidanza plate, archived with its printed caption and bibliographic record.
